request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The people, claims and pools exports taken while an as-of date is set use the as-of figures.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The people, claims and pools exports now use the as-of figures when an as-of date is set. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**What was wrong:** the people and claims exports already used as-of figures. The pools export didn't: its "cut" column was worked out from the sheet's current pot, because the app never kept a history of the pot. In the test the pot was 10.00 on 2026-03-01 and 20.00 later, so the as-of cut came out as 20.00 when it should have been 10.00.

**What I changed:**
- **New migration `V95__sheet_revision_pot.sql`:** sheet history records (`sheet_revision`) now store the pot alongside the policy date. Each sheet that already has a pot gets one starting record dated to its today, the same way the original history migration started everything else.
- **`SheetRevision`:** has the new `pot` field, plus a check for whether a record still matches the sheet's current policy date and pot.
- **`History`:** a new history record is written when either the policy date or the pot changes. `SheetAsOf` now includes the pot as it stood on the as-of day.
- **`SheetService.setPot`:** now writes to the history, as the other setting changes already do.
- **`PoolService.list`:** when an as-of date is set, it uses the as-of pot. The pool rows on screen also come from this list, so they now show as-of cuts too, not just the export.

**Limits:**
- Pot changes made before this migration weren't recorded. An as-of date earlier than the starting record finds no pot, so no cuts are shown for that date.
- Copying a sheet sets the new sheet's pot without writing a history record. That matches how copying treats everything else today, so I left it alone.
- The as-of settings view still shows the current pot. The request covered only the exports, so I didn't change it.
